sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default value when Nothing is encountered
sketches.resonance: When you reach into absence and find Nothing, you must decide what fills the void — and that default is all you have left.
sketches.draft:
import Data.Maybe

you :: Maybe a
you = Nothing

what_remains :: Int
what_remains = fromMaybe 0 you

sketches.mechanism: weak references automatically become nil when the referenced object is deallocated, requiring optional unwrapping to access
sketches.resonance: A weak hold on someone means waking up one day to find they've already gone, with no warning — just nil where they used to be.

sketches.mechanism: In Lua, table indexing returns nil for any key that was never set — no error, no complaint, just silent absence
sketches.resonance: You can keep asking for what was never there and the world will answer you calmly, with nothing, every single time.
sketches.draft:
memory = {}

spring = memory[1987]
summer = memory[1988]
autumn = memory[1989]
